title: 第二百章。
slug: 缺爱小可怜重回爸妈十八岁那年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

十分钟后。

秦则傻了。

“所以小青你不回家是因为你觉得我看到你们其乐融融的画面会想不开？？”

余疏沉默了。

“不是我觉得。”

“两年前，你试图自杀。”

秦则不敢置信：“——我什么时候要自杀了！？”

“我回来后的第一次家族聚餐。”

经过余疏提示，秦则想起来了。

但是……

“从小他们就嘲笑我我都习惯了，才不会把那些人的话放在心上。”

秦则意识到这误会真是大了。

有些崩溃的解释：“我当时躲在那儿看小说，就是……看到虐虐的地方，感同身受了才哭。”

“至于跳楼，我不记得了，但我肯定没这个想法！我发誓！”

“我心理健康着呢！！”

“而且我不觉得你们其乐融融有什么问题啊，那本来就是你的家人啊。”

“更何况……”

秦则说到这里，声音小了起来。

“你也是我的家人。”

刚说完，秦则发现通话被挂了。

他懵懵的看着被挂断的界面，一时之间没了表情。

在秦则茫然思考的三分钟后，他收到了一条余疏发来的消息。

：我不讨厌你

简短的五个字，让原本周身被阴云环绕的秦则的世界里出现了大太阳。

他猛的一个激灵。

从马桶上摔下去了。

“……屁股，我还没擦屁股。”

余疏面无表情的把手机扔掉了。

自诩聪明的他，从来没想到自己的人生中会出现这样的尴尬瞬间。

甚至比被祝予发现蜡笔小新袜子时还要更令人羞耻！

余疏盘腿坐在床上，盯着一头乱毛静坐许久，最终缓缓吐出一个字。

“草。”

Page (1/3)

Ten minutes later.

Qin Ze was dumbfounded.

"So Xiaoqing, you don't go home because you think I will be upset when I see you having fun??"

Yu Shu was silent.

"Not that I think."

"Two years ago, you attempted suicide."

Qin Ze couldn't believe it: "——When will I commit suicide!?"

"My first family dinner since I came back."

After Yu Shu prompted him, Qin Ze remembered.

But...

"I've been used to them laughing at me since I was a kid, so I don't take those people's words to heart."

Qin Ze realized that this misunderstanding was really big.

Some explanation for the collapse: "I was hiding there and reading novels, just... I saw the cruelty, and I cried because I felt the same."

"As for jumping off the building, I don't remember, but I definitely didn't have the idea! I swear!"

"I'm mentally healthy!!"

"And I don't think there's anything wrong with you enjoying yourself. That's your family to begin with."

"What's more..."

When Qin Ze said this, his voice became softer.

"You're my family too."

Just after he finished speaking, Qin Ze found that the call had been hung up.

He stared blankly at the interface where he was hung up, his expression lost for a moment.

Three minutes after Qin Ze thought blankly, he received a message from Yu Shu.

:I don’t hate you

These five short words made the sun appear in Qin Ze's world, which was originally surrounded by dark clouds.

He trembled violently.

Fell off the toilet.

"...Butt, I haven't wiped my butt yet."

Yu Shu threw away the phone expressionlessly.

He prides himself on being smart, but he never thought that such an embarrassing moment would appear in his life.

Even more humiliating than when Zhu Yu discovered Crayon Shin-chan’s socks!

Yu Shu sat cross-legged on the bed, staring at a mess of hair for a long time, and finally slowly uttered a word.

"Grass."
